name: elaeis oleifera seed oil
purpose: Helps promote the appearance of thicker, fuller and healthier-looking hair, and supports a healthy, nourished scalp.
uses: Do not use on broken, irritated or infected scalp, or if you are allergic to any ingredient in this product. Ask a doctor before use if you have a scalp condition or sensitive skin. When using this product avoid contact with eyes. Rinse thoroughly with water if contact occurs. Do not ingest. Stop use and ask a doctor if redness, irritation or rash develops and does not improve within 7 days.
